products.name: Falcon (TII)
products.note: UAE-hosted open-source LLM; sovereign AI; Apache 2.0; Middle East data residency

profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute is a non-profit government research laboratory founded in 2020, described on its site as the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). Its Falcon site presents Falcon LLM as a generative large language model family intended to advance applications and use cases, and the institute says it works to make advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere.

The Falcon family includes Falcon-H1 and Falcon-E, which the institute describes as its latest additions, with Falcon-H1 built on a hybrid Transformer and Mamba architecture. Other models named on the site include Falcon H1R 7B for reasoning in mathematics, coding, logic and instruction-following, Falcon Arabic for Modern Standard Arabic and dialects, Falcon Perception for multimodal vision and language tasks, Falcon Mamba 7B, which the institute calls the first open source released State Space Language Model, Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B with 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, Falcon 40B with 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens, and Falcon 10B. The institute states that Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, and that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google's Gemma 7B model, as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. It also announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models, and AI71, a company launched by ATRC and VentureOne, issued a call for proposals for developers to build with Falcon 10B.

The product listing for Falcon (TII) describes it as a UAE-hosted open-source LLM under Apache 2.0 licensing, positioned around sovereign AI and Middle East data residency. No litigation, regulatory filings, or other legal records are noted for the institute.
